'''Kendral''' is the grandson of King [[Paitar Nachiman]].

== Activities ==
Kendral and [[Kaisel Noramaga]] are told by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] to wait for [[Lan Mandragoran]] at the [[Silverwall Keeps]]. Both youths plan to ride with Lan to [[Tarmon Gai'don]].

== Trivia ==
* Kendral is named for Michael Kendra, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
